subject: Observability entitlements expiring — staggered migration & credit reallocation proposal
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability entitlements expiring — inventory attached

Marissa / Ben —

I pulled the entitlements extract for Datadog, Grafana Cloud, and Sentry; several key addons and retention buckets are due within the next 90–120 days. Attaching the CSV (entitlements_extract.csv). Topline findings:

- Datadog: Most core agent/ingest entitlements run to Sept–Oct. Two retention add-ons (high-frequency logs) are up in August.
- Grafana Cloud: Snapshot/metrics credit tranche renews in late July.
- Sentry: Rate-limit credits and the session-replay addon renew in September.

We need a plan that avoids a single-month spike in cash commitments and preserves our ability to negotiate credits or rollovers. My proposal: a staggered renewal approach + temporary cross-vendor credit reallocation where vendors allow it, plus a short runway of burst credits for Q3 traffic.

Ask: Can procurement/finance prepare a quick cost-model for the staggered timeline below? Ben — can you run a 12-month TCO with and without retaining current high-frequency log retention? Marissa — can you check procurement playbooks for vendor rollover/credit reissue rules (esp. Datadog)?

Proposed timeline (high level):
- July: Renew Grafana Cloud core metrics; negotiate snapshot credits to be prorated.
- Aug: Reconcile Datadog high-frequency retention add-ons — attempt to move 20% to nearline/archival storage and request credits.
- Sept: Renew Sentry with revised rate-limit profile after instrumentation changes.

I want a one-pager we can present to finance by EOD Wednesday (2026-06-09). I can draft the executive summary.

Thanks,
Dylan

--
Dylan Brooks
Head of Infrastructure Finance (acting)
Redwood Inference

On Mon, Jun 7, 2026 at 09:12 AM Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I pulled the entitlements extract for Datadog, Grafana Cloud, and Sentry; several key addons and retention buckets are due within the next 90–120 days.

Thanks for the export, Dylan. Quick notes after a first pass:

- Procurement playbook: vendors often allow one-time prorated credits for account-level consolidations but rarely allow cross-vendor credit transfers. We'll push for Datadog prorates and any unused Grafana commit carryover.
- Contract caveats: Datadog's retention add-ons are licensed per-ingest and have specific egress/archival clauses — moving data to nearline will likely require an egress addendum.
- Sentry: they have a 30-day grace but their session-replay add-on is billed upfront. We can ask for credits if usage dips after our instrumentation changes.

Attached a quick matrix I built (vendor_renewal_matrix.pdf) and will add a modeled savings tab to the shared workbook.

Next steps:
1) Ben to produce the TCO variants.
2) I'll open a case with Datadog sales to ask about prorate and rollover policy (will cc you on the thread).
3) Neha, can you check whether finance can stretch any remaining FY26 budget to smooth the July spike?

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Director, Procurement
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 14:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability entitlements expiring — inventory attached

Dylan / Marissa —

I ran the quick TCO scenarios; attaching savings_model_v2.xlsx (summary below). Two scenarios:

A) Status quo renewals (no tier changes): 12-month run-rate = $1.08M; Q3 cash hit concentrated in July–Sept.
B) Stagger + archive: 12-month run-rate = $930k (14% savings) if we move 30% of high-frequency logs to nearline cold storage and reduce retention add-on footprint.

Risks & assumptions:
- We assume archival egress will be ~3–4% of current ingest spend; vendor egress fees could change this math.
- Datadog negotiations: based on prior conversations, they may offer credits equalling 10–20% of the add-on spend if we sign a 12-month commit on core agents.
- Operational impact: storage move requires an infra sprint to ensure log processors respect new lifecycle (I can coordinate with platform squads).

If we want to avoid a July spike altogether, we could delay Grafana snapshot commit until Aug but we'd lose negotiation leverage. My recommendation: follow Dylan's staggered timeline and prioritize forcing Datadog to the negotiation table for the high-frequency retention add-ons in Aug.

Ben

Attachment: savings_model_v2.xlsx (contains scenario tab + assumptions)
From: Datadog Sales <datadog-sales@datadoghq.com>

Hi Marissa / Dylan —

Thanks for sending the entitlements extract and the renewal matrix. Quick reply from the Datadog side:

- We can offer a one-time prorated credit for up to 15% of eligible high-frequency retention spend if you commit to a 12-month minimum for core agent/ingest.
- We do require an egress addendum for any formal nearline migration that reduces live retention; without the addendum we can't guarantee zero egress charges.
- If you need a short-term burst buffer for Q3, we can provision temporary ingest credits for July (billed at usage but discounted 10% if pooled into the renewal).

I'll set up a 30-minute call with your procurement and engineering leads to walk the entitlements and discuss the egress language. Suggest Wed 2026-06-09 10:00 PT.

Best,
Datadog Sales

Marissa / Ben / Neha —

Thanks for the quick turn. Based on Ben's numbers and Datadog's initial offer, here's what we'll present to finance and execs tomorrow:

1) Proceed with the staggered renewal timeline as proposed.
2) Target ask to Datadog: 15% prorated credit on high-frequency retention add-ons + 10% discounted temporary ingest credits for July.
3) Delay Grafana snapshot commit by 30 days to create negotiation runway (Marissa to confirm implications).
4) Start the nearline migration POC immediately with Platform; goal to move 30% of HF logs to nearline by end of Q3.

Marissa: please open the Datadog meeting invite for Wed 2026-06-09 10:00 PT and attach the savings_model_v2.xlsx and vendor_renewal_matrix.pdf.

If anyone sees a blocker, flag now. I'll take the one-pager to finance.

Dylan
